The modifications in the `rtl8365mb.c` file are aimed at addressing a concurrency issue during indirect PHY register access. The introduction of mutex locking around the critical sections of code further enforces this serialization, preventing simultaneous access to the registers that could compromise the integrity of the PHY read/write operations. This change is crucial for maintaining the stability and reliability of the PHY subsystem, particularly in scenarios where multiple threads or processes may attempt to access the switch registers concurrently.
